_comment: Homepage hero. Edit this file to change the headline or swap the clips. No code change needed. Keep exactly three panels: the band is a single continuous strip divided into thirds.
headline: Know what you earned.
lede: You earned these benefits. Finding them should not be a second deployment. USVetHub gathers what each state offers Veterans and their families, in plain language, with a link to the official source for every single entry.
_videos: src and poster must be site-relative paths under /video/. The Content Security Policy allows media from our own origin only, so a remote URL will be blocked, not merely discouraged. Encode with: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -an -vf scale=760:-2:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 31 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 24 -movflags +faststart out.mp4. Strip the audio track: the panels are muted, so an audio stream is pure wasted bandwidth. Total video weight is capped at 12 MB by a build test.
_captions: Captions are the message, file names describe the footage. Served is the Marines hiking clip, Connected is the handshake, Supported is the Veteran being thanked.
_releases: Signed releases confirmed held by Tony on 2026-08-29 for all three panels. This field is a POINTER ONLY. Never put a release document, a signature, a person name, or any contact detail in this repo: it is public, and GitHub Pages publishes every file it is given. Record only where the paperwork lives.
